items.reason_zh: Windows Win32K graphics subsystem存在基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，攻击者可通过利用内核内存损坏实现本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows GDI+ enables local code execution through maliciously crafted image files processed by the graphics library.
items.reason_zh: Windows GDI+ 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过图形库处理的恶意构造图像文件实现本地代码执行。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Chromium-based Edge browser engine permits remote code execution when rendering untrusted web content.
items.reason_zh: 基于 Chromium 的 Edge 浏览器引擎中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，在渲染不受信任的 Web 内容时可导致远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in the Remote Desktop Client allows attackers to execute arbitrary code over the network by exploiting the RDP connection handshake.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Client 中的堆溢出漏洞允许攻击者利用 RDP 连接握手过程在网络中执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in Visual Studio Code enables unauthorized remote code execution, compromising developer workstations and source code repositories.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中缺失授权检查可导致未授权的远程代码执行，危及开发人员工作站和源代码仓库。

items.reason_en: Authorization bypass in Visual Studio Code allows local attackers to circumvent security features, directly threatening development environment integrity.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中的授权绕过漏洞允许本地攻击者规避安全功能，直接威胁开发环境的完整性。

items.reason_en: Untrusted search path in Windows Narrator Braille enables local privilege escalation, compromising accessibility software on enterprise desktops.
items.reason_zh: Windows Narrator Braille 中的不受信任的搜索路径漏洞可导致本地权限提升，危及企业桌面设备上的辅助功能软件。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows LUAFV permits authorized local attackers to elevate privileges, weakening core OS security mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: Windows LUAFV 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许已授权的本地攻击者提升权限，削弱核心操作系统的安全机制。

items.reason_en: Hardcoded directory path flaw in Acunetix scanning engine enables local privilege escalation to SYSTEM, undermining security assessment toolchains.
items.reason_zh: Acunetix 扫描引擎中的硬编码目录路径缺陷可导致本地权限提升至 SYSTEM 级别，破坏安全评估工具链。

items.reason_en: Missing validation in PassMark's DirectIo64.sys driver allows local users to clear arbitrary physical memory bits, facilitating privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: PassMark 的 DirectIo64.sys 驱动程序中缺失验证机制，允许本地用户清除任意物理内存位，从而促进权限提升。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated physical memory disclosure via PassMark driver IOCTLs exposes sensitive kernel data to unprivileged local users.
items.reason_zh: 通过 PassMark 驱动的 IOCTLs 接口可发生未认证的物理内存泄露，将敏感内核数据暴露给无特权的本地用户。

items.reason_en: Untrusted .env file overriding Gemini CLI home directory enables arbitrary code execution, compromising developer environments and cloud tooling.
items.reason_zh: 不受信任的 .env 文件覆盖 Gemini CLI 主目录可导致任意代码执行，危及开发环境和云工具链。

items.reason_en: Trusting attacker-writable clipboard MIME types in SiYuan Note enables script execution upon paste, compromising the desktop renderer.
items.reason_zh: SiYuan Note 中盲目信任攻击者可写的剪贴板 MIME 类型可在粘贴时触发脚本执行，危及桌面渲染器。

items.reason_en: Prototype pollution in Adobe Acrobat Reader enables arbitrary file system reads, exposing sensitive documents to malicious PDF payloads.
items.reason_zh: Adobe Acrobat Reader 中的原型链污染漏洞可导致任意文件系统读取，使敏感文档暴露于恶意 PDF 载荷之下。

items.reason_en: The libXfont2 font server client uses unvalidated array indices derived from separate replies, causing out-of-bounds memory access that can lead to remote code execution in desktop environments.
items.reason_zh: libXfont2 字体服务器客户端使用源自不同回复且未经验证的数组索引，导致越界内存访问，可能在桌面环境中引发远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Acrobat Reader's heap-based buffer overflow allows arbitrary code execution when users open malicious PDF files, posing a significant risk due to the application's widespread enterprise deployment.
items.reason_zh: Acrobat Reader 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许用户在打开恶意 PDF 文件时执行任意代码，鉴于该应用在企业环境中的广泛部署，存在重大风险。

items.reason_en: Listed in CISA KEV due to active exploitation; allows local privilege escalation on Windows systems by abusing the Common Log File System driver.
items.reason_zh: 因遭活跃利用被列入 CISA KEV；通过滥用 Common Log File System 驱动程序可在 Windows 系统上实现本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: AMD Zen 2 CPU flaw enables cross-privilege instruction corruption via shared cache resources, posing a serious threat to desktop and workstation security.
items.reason_zh: AMD Zen 2 CPU 缺陷允许通过共享缓存资源进行跨特权指令篡改，对桌面和工作站安全构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in Microsoft Authenticator allows unauthorized local privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Authenticator 中的身份验证绕过漏洞允许未授权的本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Improper authorization in Xbox Gaming Services enables local privilege escalation by authenticated users.
items.reason_zh: Xbox Gaming Services 中的授权不当允许已认证用户实现本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: High-severity flaw in the Lenovo Health Android app (CVSS 9.1) allows attackers to access highly sensitive personal health data, highlighting regional mobile app risks.
items.reason_zh: Lenovo Health Android 应用中的高危漏洞（CVSS 9.1）允许攻击者访问高度敏感的个人健康数据，凸显了区域移动应用的风险。

items.reason_en: Improper input validation in the Samsung DualDAR driver allows local privileged attackers to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on Android devices.
items.reason_zh: Samsung DualDAR 驱动程序中的输入验证不当允许本地特权攻击者在 Android 设备上以 root 权限执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in the DualDAR driver enables local root code execution, posing a severe risk to mobile device integrity and data confidentiality.
items.reason_zh: DualDAR 驱动程序中的释放后使用（Use-after-free）漏洞可实现本地 root 代码执行，对移动设备的完整性和数据机密性构成严重风险。

items.reason_en: Path traversal vulnerability in Microsoft Teams for Android allows unauthorized remote code execution, severely impacting mobile endpoint security.
items.reason_zh: Android 版 Microsoft Teams 中的路径遍历漏洞允许未授权的远程代码执行，严重影响移动端终端安全。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in Samsung's libmdnie.so enables local privilege escalation to system server, destabilizing mobile OS architecture.
items.reason_zh: Samsung libmdnie.so 中的越界写入漏洞可导致本地权限提升至 system server，破坏移动操作系统架构的稳定性。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflows in Samsung's DNG and JPEG image decoders enable remote attackers to execute arbitrary code by processing specially crafted image files on affected mobile devices.
items.reason_zh: Samsung DNG 和 JPEG 图像解码器中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许远程攻击者通过在受影响移动设备上处理特制图像文件来执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Similar to the DNG flaw, the JPEG decoder vulnerability allows remote code execution via malformed images, directly compromising the core multimedia subsystem of Samsung smartphones.
items.reason_zh: 与 DNG 缺陷类似，JPEG 解码器漏洞允许通过畸形图像实现远程代码执行，直接危及 Samsung 智能手机的核心多媒体子系统。

items.reason_en: Missing permission check in Android's PermissionsManager allows unprivileged apps to monitor sensitive device state data locally without user interaction.
items.reason_zh: Android PermissionsManager 中缺失权限检查允许无特权应用在无需用户交互的情况下本地监控敏感的设备状态数据。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in the TP-Link Deco router's TDDP module permits adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges, completely compromising smart home network infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: TP-Link Deco 路由器的 TDDP 模块中存在操作系统命令注入漏洞，允许相邻攻击者以 root 权限执行任意命令，完全破坏智能家居网络基础设施。

items.reason_en: Remote OS command injection in Tenda CP3 router firmware allows unauthenticated attackers to fully compromise consumer networking hardware.
items.reason_zh: Tenda CP3 路由器固件中的远程操作系统命令注入漏洞允许未认证攻击者完全控制消费级网络设备。

items.reason_en: Authenticated ONVIF users on GeoVision IP cameras can inject shell commands to achieve root-level remote code execution, breaching video surveillance security.
items.reason_zh: GeoVision IP 摄像机上已认证的 ONVIF 用户可注入 Shell 命令以实现 root 级别的远程代码执行，突破视频监控安全防护。

items.reason_en: Malformed USB packets from malicious CP210x devices corrupt kernel pool memory, enabling local unprivileged users to escalate privileges on host systems.
items.reason_zh: 来自恶意CP210x设备的畸形USB数据包会破坏内核池内存，使本地未授权用户能够在主机系统上实现提权。

items.reason_en: Allows arbitrary command execution as root on GeoVision IP cameras through crafted wireless SSIDs, fully compromising device integrity and network segmentation.
items.reason_zh: 通过构造的无线SSID，可在GeoVision IP摄像头上以root身份执行任意命令，完全破坏设备完整性及网络隔离。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated remote command injection in Dell ThinOS 10 poses critical risk to thin client deployments, enabling immediate system takeover.
items.reason_zh: Dell ThinOS 10中存在未认证的远程命令注入漏洞，对瘦客户端部署构成严重风险，可导致攻击者立即接管系统。

items.reason_en: Remote command injection in Dell ThinOS 10 enables full system compromise by high-privileged attackers with remote access capabilities.
items.reason_zh: Dell ThinOS 10中的远程命令注入漏洞可使具备远程访问能力的高权限攻击者完全控制系统。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated PTZ service exposure in GeoVision cameras allows remote command issuance and state retrieval, severely compromising physical security.
items.reason_zh: GeoVision摄像机中未认证的PTZ服务暴露允许远程下发命令和获取状态，严重破坏物理安全。

items.reason_en: Lack of nonce protection in GeoVision cameras allows token replay attacks, enabling unauthorized PTZ and streaming operations over ONVIF.
items.reason_zh: GeoVision摄像机缺乏nonce保护，易受Token重放攻击影响，导致攻击者可通过ONVIF协议执行未授权的PTZ控制和流媒体操作。

items.reason_en: Open redirect vulnerability in Armiya Access Control System facilitates phishing and data source spoofing, undermining physical security gateways.
items.reason_zh: Armiya门禁系统中存在开放重定向漏洞，可助长钓鱼攻击和数据源伪造，削弱物理安全网关防护。

items.reason_en: Attacker-controlled message length parsing in Bosch BHI385 SDK triggers stack-based buffer overflow, risking embedded firmware compromise.
items.reason_zh: Bosch BHI385 SDK中对攻击者可控消息长度的解析会触发基于栈的缓冲区溢出，危及嵌入式固件安全。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Bosch PC bridge decoder allows denial of service or arbitrary code execution in connected sensor ecosystems.
items.reason_zh: Bosch PC网桥解码器中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致连接的传感器生态系统发生拒绝服务或任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: Low-privilege users can invoke unauthorized API interfaces in HikCentral Access Control, breaching role-based access controls in surveillance systems.
items.reason_zh: 低权限用户可在HikCentral门禁系统中调用未授权的API接口，破坏监控系统的基于角色访问控制机制。

items.reason_en: Embedded UEFI shell commands can circumvent Secure Boot protections, undermining the hardware trust chain required for secure boot processes in IoT and embedded devices.
items.reason_zh: 嵌入的UEFI Shell命令可绕过安全启动防护，破坏IoT和嵌入式设备安全启动流程所需的硬件信任链。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated SQL injection in physical access control software allows attackers to fully manipulate the underlying database, compromising physical security infrastructure and sensor networks.
items.reason_zh: 物理访问控制软件中存在未认证的SQL注入漏洞，攻击者可完全操控底层数据库，破坏物理安全基础设施与传感器网络。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in TP-Link router firmware enables authenticated local attackers to execute arbitrary code via crafted configuration uploads.
items.reason_zh: TP-Link路由器固件中存在基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，已认证本地攻击者可通过构造配置上传文件执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Critical authorization bypass in Azure Active Directory B2C allows unauthorized privilege elevation over the network, directly undermining core identity and access management controls.
items.reason_zh: Azure Active Directory B2C中存在关键授权绕过漏洞，允许通过网络进行未授权权限提升，直接破坏核心身份与访问管理控制机制。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in Azure AI Language exposes critical cloud AI services to unauthenticated access, risking data leakage, model abuse, and service degradation at scale.
items.reason_zh: Azure AI Language缺失身份认证，导致关键云AI服务面临未授权访问风险，可能引发大规模数据泄露、模型滥用及服务降级。

items.reason_en: Improper cryptographic signature verification in Copilot Studio undermines trust in AI-generated content and automated workflows, enabling potential privilege escalation and logic manipulation.
items.reason_zh: Copilot Studio中不正确的密码学签名验证机制破坏了用户对AI生成内容及自动化工作流的信任，可能导致权限提升与逻辑篡改。

items.reason_en: Authentication flaws in Spring Cloud Azure affect developer toolchains and microservices architectures, potentially granting unauthorized access to cloud resources across distributed systems.
items.reason_zh: Spring Cloud Azure中的身份认证缺陷影响开发者工具链与微服务架构，可能导致跨分布式系统未授权访问云资源。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 stack-based buffer overflow in Windows Hyper-V allows network remote code execution, directly threatening virtualized cloud workloads and host isolation.
items.reason_zh: Windows Hyper-V中存在CVSS 9.8的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致网络远程代码执行，直接威胁虚拟化云工作负载与主机隔离安全。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 unsafe deserialization in Microsoft Dynamics 365 enables network remote code execution, exposing SaaS cloud deployments to compromise.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Dynamics 365中存在CVSS 8.8的不安全反序列化漏洞，可导致网络远程代码执行，使SaaS云部署面临被攻陷风险。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 heap buffer overflow in Windows Management Services allows network privilege escalation, impacting cloud management agents and orchestration tools.
items.reason_zh: Windows Management Services中存在CVSS 8.8的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致网络权限提升，影响云管理代理与编排工具安全。

items.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in Hyper-V poses a hypervisor escape risk, allowing local code execution.
items.reason_zh: Hyper-V中存在不受信任的指针解引用漏洞，存在Hypervisor逃逸风险，可导致本地代码执行。

items.reason_en: Code injection vulnerability in Dynamics 365 allows remote code execution within cloud environments.
items.reason_zh: Dynamics 365中存在代码注入漏洞，可在云环境中实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in Azure HDInsights enables privilege escalation and potential server compromise.
items.reason_zh: Azure HDInsights中存在OS命令注入漏洞，可导致权限提升及潜在的服务器被控风险。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in Microsoft Entra ID (CVSS 9.9) enables network-based privilege escalation, directly impacting global identity management infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Entra ID（CVSS 9.9）缺失授权检查，可实现基于网络的权限提升，直接影响全球身份管理基础设施。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in Microsoft Entra ID allows unauthorized elevation of privileges over the network, threatening multi-tenant cloud access controls.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Entra ID中存在身份认证绕过漏洞，允许通过网络进行未授权权限提升，威胁多租户云访问控制安全。

items.reason_en: Permissive cross-domain policy in Azure Arc exposes cloud-managed resources to unauthorized privilege escalation via network attacks.
items.reason_zh: Azure Arc中宽松的跨域策略使云托管资源面临通过网络攻击进行未授权权限提升的风险。

items.reason_en: Authorization bypass in HashiCorp Consul Connect service mesh allows services to access unauthorized destinations, breaking zero-trust network segmentation.
items.reason_zh: HashiCorp Consul Connect服务网格中存在授权绕过漏洞，允许服务访问未授权目标，破坏零信任网络隔离机制。

items.reason_en: Information disclosure in consul-template leaks Vault secret values through error messages and logs, exposing sensitive cloud infrastructure credentials.
items.reason_zh: consul-template中存在信息泄露漏洞，错误消息与日志会泄露Vault密钥值，暴露敏感云基础设施凭证。

items.reason_en: Container runtime regression in Red Hat crun allows containers with passt networking to escape and execute payloads with host root privileges.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat crun容器运行时存在回归缺陷，允许使用passt网络的容器逃逸并执行具有宿主机root权限的有效载荷。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Azure SQL Database enables unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges over the network, threatening cloud database availability and integrity.
items.reason_zh: Azure SQL Database中存在服务端请求伪造（SSRF）漏洞，可使未授权攻击者通过网络提升权限，威胁云数据库的可用性与完整性。

items.reason_en: Critical privilege escalation in Azure Arc impacts cloud management infrastructure, potentially allowing unauthorized control over hybrid environments.
items.reason_zh: Azure Arc 中的关键权限提升漏洞影响云管理基础设施，可能导致攻击者未经授权控制混合环境。

items.reason_en: Argument injection in Azure Managed Instance for Apache Cassandra enables remote code execution without authentication, threatening data integrity and availability.
items.reason_zh: Azure Managed Instance for Apache Cassandra 中的参数注入漏洞可在未认证情况下实现远程代码执行，威胁数据完整性与可用性。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in Azure CycleCloud enables unauthorized users to escalate privileges over the network, risking tenant isolation breaches.
items.reason_zh: Azure CycleCloud 中缺失授权检查，允许未经身份验证的用户通过网络提升权限，危及租户隔离安全。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Azure Storage Explorer can lead to session hijacking and sensitive storage data exposure for cloud administrators.
items.reason_zh: Azure Storage Explorer 中存在跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞，可能导致会话劫持及云管理员敏感存储数据泄露。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Dynamics 365 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code, threatening enterprise cloud workloads.
items.reason_zh: Dynamics 365 中存在不信任数据反序列化漏洞，允许远程攻击者执行任意代码，威胁企业云工作负载。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Entra ID grants full control over cloud identity infrastructure, enabling widespread tenant compromise.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Entra ID 中存在不信任数据反序列化漏洞，可导致攻击者完全掌控云身份基础设施，引发大规模租户沦陷。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Azure Active Directory allows attackers to pivot to internal cloud resources and escalate privileges across the identity plane.
items.reason_zh: Azure Active Directory 中存在服务器端请求伪造（SSRF）漏洞，允许攻击者横向移动到内部云资源并在身份平面提升权限。

items.reason_en: Critical SSRF in Exchange Online facilitates privilege escalation and data exfiltration by forcing the service to interact with internal endpoints.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Online 中存在关键 SSRF 漏洞，通过强制服务与内部端点交互，协助攻击者提升权限并窃取数据。

items.reason_en: Improper cryptographic signature verification in the Microsoft 365 Admin Center undermines trust mechanisms, allowing unauthorized administrative actions.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft 365 管理中心存在密码学签名验证不当问题，破坏信任机制，导致攻击者可执行未授权的后台管理操作。

items.reason_en: Modification of assumed-immutable data in Azure Active Directory permits attackers to alter critical identity attributes without detection.
items.reason_zh: Azure Active Directory 中存在假定不可变数据被篡改漏洞，允许攻击者在未被察觉的情况下修改关键身份属性。

items.reason_en: Critical deserialization flaw in Azure Service Bus enables network-based code execution by authorized attackers, posing severe risk to cloud workloads.
items.reason_zh: Azure Service Bus 中存在关键反序列化缺陷，允许已认证的攻击者通过网络执行代码，对云工作负载构成严重风险。

items.reason_en: Authentication flaw in Microsoft Teams enables privilege escalation over the network, threatening enterprise communication infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Teams 中存在身份验证缺陷，允许攻击者通过网络提升权限，威胁企业通信基础设施。

items.reason_en: Accepting client-supplied loopback headers in DeepSeek Harness bypasses authentication, granting unauthenticated control over local AI agent APIs.
items.reason_zh: DeepSeek Harness 接受客户端提供的回环（loopback）头信息可绕过身份验证，赋予攻击者对本地 AI 代理 API 的未认证控制权。

items.reason_en: Unrestricted direct table writes in Capgo's Supabase API bypass SSO provisioning, enabling unauthorized access enforcement across cloud applications.
items.reason_zh: Capgo 的 Supabase API 中存在无限制的直接表写入漏洞，可绕过单点登录（SSO）配置，导致跨云应用的未授权访问生效。

items.reason_en: Improper jq filter validation in IBM ContextForge MCP Gateway enables credential extraction and privilege escalation in cloud gateway services.
items.reason_zh: IBM ContextForge MCP Gateway 中存在 jq 过滤器验证不当问题，可导致凭据提取和云网关服务中的权限提升。

items.reason_en: Email-only OAuth binding in Coolify allows account takeover by registering victim emails on any enabled provider, bypassing identity verification.
items.reason_zh: Coolify 中仅基于电子邮件的 OAuth 绑定漏洞允许攻击者在任意启用的提供商上注册受害者邮箱，从而接管账户并绕过身份验证。

items.reason_en: Environment validation failure in Trigger.dev allows task injection across organizations, consuming victim resources and potentially exfiltrating data.
items.reason_zh: Trigger.dev 中存在环境验证失败漏洞，允许跨组织注入任务，消耗受害者资源并可能窃取数据。

items.reason_en: Improper configuration processing in Auth0 AD/LDAP connector allows low-privileged users to modify settings, triggering service restart and code execution.
items.reason_zh: Auth0 AD/LDAP 连接器中存在配置处理不当问题，允许低权限用户修改设置，触发服务重启并执行代码。

items.reason_en: Prefix-matching OIDC subject identifiers in Red Hat SSSD enables authentication bypass for IdPs with overlapping identifier prefixes.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat SSSD 中存在前缀匹配 OIDC 主题标识符漏洞，允许具有重叠标识符前缀的身份提供商（IdP）绕过身份验证。

items.reason_en: DOM cross-site scripting in FreeIPA's password reset page enables credential theft and account takeover via crafted reset links.
items.reason_zh: FreeIPA 密码重置页面中存在 DOM 型跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞，可通过构造的重置链接窃取凭据并接管账户。

items.reason_en: Traefik mishandles Kubernetes Ingress annotations containing both authentication and redirect directives, creating a path for attackers to bypass authentication and expose internal cluster services.
items.reason_zh: Traefik 错误处理同时包含身份验证和重定向指令的 Kubernetes Ingress 注解，为攻击者绕过身份验证并暴露内部集群服务提供了途径。

items.reason_en: OpenStack's keystonemiddleware fails to sanitize incoming OAuth 2.0 authentication headers, allowing forged requests to bypass identity verification in major open-source cloud deployments.
items.reason_zh: OpenStack 的 keystonemiddleware 未能清理传入的 OAuth 2.0 身份验证头信息，导致伪造请求可绕过身份验证，影响主流开源云部署。

items.reason_en: KubeVirt's improper symlink validation in virtual machine console sockets allows namespace-isolated users to escape isolation and access sensitive VM resources, breaking cloud tenant boundaries.
items.reason_zh: KubeVirt 在虚拟机控制台套接字中存在符号链接验证不当问题，允许命名空间隔离用户逃逸隔离并访问敏感虚拟机资源，破坏云租户边界。

items.reason_en: OpenShift Router misconfiguration allows endpoint writers to proxy requests to cloud metadata endpoints, risking credential theft from underlying infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: OpenShift Router 配置错误允许端点编写者将请求代理到云元数据端点，面临从底层基础设施窃取凭据的风险。

items.reason_en: Podman's kube play command fails to properly validate symbolic links in volume mounts, allowing containerized workloads to overwrite arbitrary host files.
items.reason_zh: Podman 的 kube play 命令未能正确验证卷挂载中的符号链接，允许容器化工作负载覆盖任意主机文件。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 weak authentication in Windows iSCSI allows unauthorized attackers to bypass security features and manipulate storage traffic over the network.
items.reason_zh: Windows iSCSI 存在 CVSS 评分 9.8 的弱身份验证漏洞，允许未授权攻击者绕过安全功能并通过网络操纵存储流量。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.1 use-after-free in Windows DNS enables network remote code execution, posing a critical risk to infrastructure name resolution services.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS 存在 CVSS 评分 8.1 的释放后使用（UAF）漏洞，可实现网络远程代码执行，对基础设施名称解析服务构成严重风险。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.1 stack-based buffer overflow in Windows DHCP Server allows network remote code execution, threatening IP address management systems.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server 存在 CVSS 评分 8.1 的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可实现网络远程代码执行，威胁 IP 地址管理系统。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.1 use-after-free in Windows SMB Client facilitates network remote code execution, significantly increasing lateral movement risks in domain environments.
items.reason_zh: Windows SMB Client 存在 CVSS 评分 8.1 的释放后使用（UAF）漏洞，可促进网络远程代码执行，显著增加域环境中的横向移动风险。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in DHCP Server permits remote code execution, potentially compromising network infrastructure and enabling lateral movement across subnets.
items.reason_zh: DHCP Server 中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许远程代码执行，可能破坏网络基础设施并实现在子网间的横向移动。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Windows DNS allows unauthenticated remote code execution, threatening core name resolution services and network accessibility.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS 中的释放后使用漏洞允许未经身份验证的远程代码执行，威胁核心名称解析服务与网络可访问性。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in DHCP Server enables remote code execution, disrupting network connectivity and service availability for connected endpoints.
items.reason_zh: DHCP Server 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出可导致远程代码执行，破坏已连接终端的网络连通性与服务可用性。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the RNDIS driver allows remote code execution over adjacent networks, impacting virtualized, containerized, and mobile device networking stacks.
items.reason_zh: RNDIS 驱动程序中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出允许通过相邻网络进行远程代码执行，影响虚拟化、容器化及移动设备的网络协议栈。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in Kerberos can be exploited for denial-of-service attacks against authentication infrastructure, severely disrupting enterprise access and directory synchronization.
items.reason_zh: Kerberos 中的越界读取漏洞可被用于针对身份验证基础设施的拒绝服务攻击，严重破坏企业访问与目录同步功能。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Netlogon permits remote code execution across adjacent networks.
items.reason_zh: Netlogon 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出允许跨相邻网络进行远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in Windows Schannel allows remote code execution over the network.
items.reason_zh: Windows Schannel 中的堆溢出漏洞允许通过网络进行远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free flaw in DNS Server enables remote code execution by unauthorized network actors.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 中的释放后使用缺陷允许未授权网络主体进行远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass via capture-replay in Windows Kerberos allows remote code execution, undermining enterprise identity management.
items.reason_zh: Windows Kerberos 中通过捕获重放实现的身份验证绕过可导致远程代码执行，破坏企业身份管理。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in the Key Distribution Center permits remote code execution, critically endangering Active Directory domain controllers.
items.reason_zh: Key Distribution Center 中的释放后使用漏洞允许远程代码执行，严重危及 Active Directory 域控制器。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Network File System enables remote code execution, exposing file-sharing infrastructure to compromise.
items.reason_zh: Windows Network File System 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出可导致远程代码执行，使文件共享基础设施面临被攻陷风险。

items.reason_en: Improper null termination in the Remote Desktop Protocol can disclose sensitive information over the network, aiding reconnaissance efforts.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Protocol 中的空字符终止不当可通过网络泄露敏感信息，辅助攻击者侦察。

items.reason_en: Type confusion in Suricata's HTTP/2 parser (CVSS 9.1) can cause application crashes and potential remote code execution in network intrusion detection systems.
items.reason_zh: Suricata 的 HTTP/2 解析器中存在类型混淆漏洞（CVSS 9.1），可能导致网络入侵检测系统应用崩溃及潜在的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Race condition in the Windows DNS Server allows unauthenticated remote code execution over the network, destabilizing critical name resolution services.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS Server 中的竞争条件漏洞允许通过网络进行未经身份验证的远程代码执行，导致关键名称解析服务失稳。

items.reason_en: RouterOS state manipulation flaw allows unauthenticated clients to trigger UDP tests that transmit uninitialized kernel packet buffer data, risking network instability.
items.reason_zh: RouterOS 的状态操纵缺陷允许未认证客户端触发 UDP 测试，传输未初始化的内核数据包缓冲区数据，引发网络不稳定风险。

items.reason_en: SSH login path argument-handling flaw in RouterOS changes trusted policy masks, leading to privilege escalation and complete router compromise.
items.reason_zh: RouterOS 中 SSH 登录路径参数处理缺陷会篡改受信任策略掩码，导致权限提升及路由器完全沦陷。

items.reason_en: NULL pointer dereference in Suricata's Lua TLS certificate helper causes denial of service in network intrusion detection and monitoring appliances.
items.reason_zh: Suricata 的 Lua TLS 证书辅助程序中的空指针解引用会导致网络入侵检测与监控设备发生拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: High-severity heap overflow in the Windows iSCSI Target Service allows remote code execution over network protocols commonly used in enterprise storage networks.
items.reason_zh: Windows iSCSI Target Service 中的高危堆溢出漏洞允许通过企业存储网络常用协议进行远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows DHCP Server enables remote code execution, compromising network infrastructure and enabling lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出可导致远程代码执行，破坏网络基础设施并支持横向移动。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Windows DNS permits remote code execution without authentication, directly impacting network infrastructure reliability and security.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS 中的释放后使用漏洞允许免认证远程代码执行，直接影响网络基础设施的可靠性与安全性。

items.reason_en: Improper link resolution in the DHCP Server can be leveraged for local privilege escalation or service disruption within enterprise networks.
items.reason_zh: DHCP Server 中的链路解析不当可被利用于在企业网络中进行本地权限提升或服务中断。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in the Windows RPC API exposes critical remote procedure calls to unauthorized elevation, weakening network defense layers.
items.reason_zh: Windows RPC API 中缺失身份验证机制会使关键远程过程调用暴露于未授权提权操作下，削弱网络防御体系。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Windows DNS enables remote code execution by exploiting malformed DNS queries against widely deployed resolvers.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞可通过利用针对广泛部署解析器的畸形 DNS 查询实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in Microsoft QUIC allows network-based code execution by corrupting memory during modern transport protocol operations.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft QUIC 中的释放后使用漏洞可在现代传输协议运行期间通过破坏内存实现基于网络的代码执行。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution in Windows RRAS compromises routing and remote access gateways, facilitating unauthorized network entry and lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: Windows RRAS 中的远程代码执行漏洞会破坏路由与远程访问网关，助长未授权网络接入与横向移动。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Windows LDAP exposes directory services to remote code execution, threatening enterprise authentication and authorization systems.
items.reason_zh: Windows LDAP 中的释放后使用漏洞使目录服务面临远程代码执行风险，威胁企业身份认证与授权系统。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in Windows DNS responders enables adjacent network exploitation through crafted packet injections.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS 响应程序中的越界写入漏洞可通过构造的数据包注入实现相邻网络攻击。

items.reason_en: Shared transport issue in Traefik's HTTP/3 entrypoint undermines Kerberos authentication isolation, risking credential interception between connections.
items.reason_zh: Traefik 的 HTTP/3 入口点存在共享传输问题，破坏了 Kerberos 身份验证隔离机制，存在连接间凭据被拦截的风险。

items.reason_en: Improper routing evaluation in Traefik reverse proxy allows path sanitization bypasses, potentially exposing backend services to unauthorized access.
items.reason_zh: Traefik 反向代理中的路由评估不当允许绕过路径过滤机制，可能导致后端服务暴露于未授权访问之下。

items.reason_en: TLS option naming collision in Traefik Kubernetes provider bypasses authentication, exposing ingress routes to unauthorized traffic.
items.reason_zh: Traefik Kubernetes 提供程序中的 TLS 选项命名冲突会绕过身份验证，使入口路由暴露于未授权流量之下。

items.reason_en: Argument injection in LibreNMS graph generation allows authenticated attackers to read unauthorized RRD files, exposing network monitoring data.
items.reason_zh: LibreNMS 图表生成中的参数注入漏洞允许已认证攻击者读取未授权的 RRD 文件，导致网络监控数据泄露。

items.reason_en: Unbounded HTTP/2 decompression in Suricata allows crafted payloads to exhaust buffers, degrading intrusion detection and prevention performance.
items.reason_zh: Suricata 中无限制的 HTTP/2 解压缩允许构造的载荷耗尽缓冲区，降低入侵检测与防御性能。

items.reason_en: Web interface vulnerability in HPE ClearPass Policy Manager enables remote denial of service, disrupting network access control operations.
items.reason_zh: HPE ClearPass Policy Manager 的 Web 界面漏洞可导致远程拒绝服务，破坏网络访问控制操作。

items.reason_en: Authenticated remote attackers can achieve remote code execution on HPE ClearPass Policy Manager, disrupting enterprise network access control and policy enforcement systems.
items.reason_zh: 经身份验证的远程攻击者可在 HPE ClearPass Policy Manager 上实现远程代码执行，破坏企业网络访问控制和策略执行系统。

items.reason_en: Root-level OS command injection in Netis router diagnostic handlers allows administrators to execute arbitrary shell commands, enabling complete network takeover of consumer networking equipment.
items.reason_zh: Netis 路由器诊断处理程序中的根级操作系统命令注入允许管理员执行任意 Shell 命令，从而导致消费级网络设备被完全接管。

items.reason_en: Eclipse Jetty's HTTP/1.1 parser is vulnerable to request smuggling via chunk extensions, which can bypass WAFs, cache poisoning defenses, and session controls at reverse proxies and load balancers.
items.reason_zh: Eclipse Jetty 的 HTTP/1.1 解析器易受通过分块扩展的请求走私攻击影响，可绕过反向代理和负载均衡器上的 WAF、缓存投毒防护及会话控制。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited vulnerability enabling unauthenticated remote attackers to bypass authentication on Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center and gain root access.
items.reason_zh: 该漏洞正遭活跃利用，允许未经身份验证的远程攻击者绕过 Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center 的身份验证并获取 root 权限。

items.reason_en: Critically exploited NetScaler ADC/Gateway flaw allows remote attackers to compromise network edge appliances and disrupt critical traffic routing.
items.reason_zh: NetScaler ADC/Gateway 中的关键缺陷正遭严重利用，允许远程攻击者攻破网络边缘设备并破坏关键流量路由。

items.reason_en: Improper certificate validation during Check Point VPN negotiation permits unauthenticated remote code execution, directly compromising secure gateway infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Check Point VPN 协商期间的证书验证不当允许未经身份验证的远程代码执行，直接危及安全网关基础设施。

items.reason_en: Unbounded buffering in Suricata's DNP3 protocol parser can lead to excessive memory consumption and denial of service in industrial network monitoring deployments.
items.reason_zh: Suricata 的 DNP3 协议解析器中存在无界缓冲问题，可能导致工业网络监控部署中出现内存过度消耗和拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Weak session identifier generation in Siemens Reyrolle 7SR5 protection relays allows predictable token prediction and unauthorized industrial system access.
items.reason_zh: Siemens Reyrolle 7SR5 保护继电器中弱会话标识符生成机制允许预测令牌并导致未经授权访问工业系统。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in HMS eCatcher industrial network gateways enables remote code execution, directly threatening OT network safety and continuity.
items.reason_zh: HMS eCatcher 工业网络网关中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出可实现远程代码执行，直接威胁 OT 网络的安全性与连续性。

items.reason_en: Improper access control in NI SystemLink allows limited-privilege users to access restricted host OS files, compromising lab automation and test equipment security.
items.reason_zh: NI SystemLink 中的访问控制不当允许低权限用户访问受限的主机操作系统文件，危及实验室自动化与测试设备安全。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated directory traversal in the widely deployed AcyMailing WordPress plugin enables attackers to read sensitive server files, facilitating further reconnaissance and data exfiltration.
items.reason_zh: 广泛部署的 AcyMailing WordPress 插件存在未授权目录遍历漏洞，使攻击者能够读取敏感服务器文件，便于进一步侦察和数据外泄。

items.reason_en: Resource exhaustion vulnerability in ASP.NET Core allows unauthenticated denial-of-service attacks, threatening availability for any web application or API built on this framework.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中的资源耗尽漏洞允许未经身份验证的拒绝服务攻击，威胁基于该框架构建的任何 Web 应用或 API 的可用性。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 missing authorization in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows authenticated attackers to execute code over the network, compromising web applications.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 中缺失授权检查（CVSS 8.8）允许已认证攻击者通过网络执行代码，危及 Web 应用安全。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.3 cross-site scripting flaw in SharePoint enables network-based spoofing and phishing campaigns against end users.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的跨站脚本漏洞（CVSS 7.3）支持针对终端用户的基于网络的欺骗与钓鱼攻击。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.5 external control of file path in .NET allows unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges over the network by manipulating file operations.
items.reason_zh: .NET 中的外部控制文件路径漏洞（CVSS 7.5）允许未授权攻击者通过网络操纵文件操作来提升权限。

items.reason_en: Access control weakness in SharePoint allows remote code execution by authenticated attackers.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的访问控制弱点允许已认证攻击者实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Similar access control flaw in SharePoint compromises web application security and data integrity.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中类似的访问控制缺陷会损害 Web 应用安全与数据完整性。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Exchange Server enables spoofing and potential credential theft, severely impacting email security posture.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server 中的跨站脚本漏洞可导致欺骗与凭证窃取，严重影响电子邮件安全态势。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization checks in Exchange Server allow privilege escalation over the network, granting attackers administrative control over mail systems.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Server 中缺失的授权检查允许通过网络提升权限，使攻击者获得对邮件系统的管理控制权。

items.reason_en: External control of file paths in Exchange Server facilitates remote code execution, bypassing standard security boundaries on mail servers.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Server 中的文件路径外部控制可促成远程代码执行，绕过邮件服务器的标准安全边界。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in SharePoint Server enables authorized attackers to escalate privileges over the network, threatening web collaboration platforms.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint Server 中的 SQL 注入漏洞允许已授权攻击者通过网络提升权限，威胁 Web 协作平台。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated arbitrary file deletion in a popular WooCommerce plugin (CVSS 8.6) enables attackers to disrupt e-commerce operations and remove critical site files.
items.reason_zh: 流行的 WooCommerce 插件（CVSS 8.6）中存在未授权任意文件删除漏洞，使攻击者能够破坏电子商务运营并删除关键站点文件。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated PHP object injection in Wise Chat (CVSS 8.1) allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code by exploiting deserialization flaws in web interfaces.
items.reason_zh: Wise Chat（CVSS 8.1）中存在未授权 PHP 对象注入漏洞，允许远程攻击者通过利用 Web 接口中的反序列化缺陷执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Privilege escalation via account takeover in the WordPress Bulk Password Reset plugin (CVSS 8.0) compromises user identities and administrative credentials.
items.reason_zh: WordPress Bulk Password Reset 插件（CVSS 8.0）中通过账户接管实现的权限提升漏洞会危及用户身份与管理凭证。

items.reason_en: Angular SSR serialization flaw allows cross-site scripting by processing untrusted input inside template fallbacks, impacting modern web application frontends.
items.reason_zh: Angular SSR 中的序列化缺陷允许在处理模板回退逻辑时引入不受信任的输入，从而引发跨站脚本攻击，影响现代 Web 应用前端。

items.reason_en: OmniRoute AI gateway accepts unvalidated binary inputs and version commands, enabling remote code execution in AI model routing infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: OmniRoute AI 网关接受未验证的二进制输入与版本命令，允许在 AI 模型路由基础设施中执行远程代码。

items.reason_en: TOCTOU race condition in Plesk leads to insecure symlink following, allowing local privilege escalation to root via arbitrary file ownership takeover.
items.reason_zh: Plesk 中的 TOCTOU 竞态条件会导致不安全的符号链接跟随，允许通过任意文件所有权接管实现本地提权至 root。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in Plesk Backup Manager enables authenticated customers to write arbitrary files as root, completely compromising hosting control panels.
items.reason_zh: Plesk Backup Manager 中的路径遍历漏洞允许已认证客户以 root 权限写入任意文件，彻底破坏托管控制面板安全。

items.reason_en: passport-saml-encrypted bypasses SAML signature verification entirely, allowing attackers to forge authentication responses and hijack enterprise sessions.
items.reason_zh: passport-saml-encrypted 完全绕过了 SAML 签名验证，攻击者可伪造身份认证响应并劫持企业会话。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows attackers to execute malicious scripts in user browsers, facilitating credential theft and session hijacking.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 中的跨站脚本漏洞允许攻击者在用户浏览器中执行恶意脚本，从而导致凭据窃取和会话劫持。

items.reason_en: Unsafe deserialization of untrusted data in SharePoint enables remote code execution, posing a direct risk to web application servers and backend services.

items.reason_zh: MantisBT SOAP API 中存在严重的 Cookie 字符串重用漏洞，可导致完整的身份验证绕过，使攻击者能够冒充包括管理员在内的任何用户。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in SharePoint enables remote code execution, posing significant risks to corporate document management systems.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中对不可信数据的反序列化可导致远程代码执行，对企业文档管理系统构成重大风险。

items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的身份验证绕过漏洞可导致权限提升，可能使未授权攻击者获得对 Web 内容的管理控制权。

items.reason_zh: OpenPanel 中通过图表公式恢复 JavaScript 构造函数可使已认证用户执行任意代码，突破沙箱边界。

items.reason_zh: IBM Langflow 的工作流构建过程中存在授权绕过漏洞，允许已认证攻击者执行任意代码，危及 AI 工作流管道。

items.reason_en: Untrusted input validation in SharePoint allows network-based code execution by unauthorized attackers, impacting web application security.

items.reason_zh: Joomla 的 SP Property 模块查询构建器中存在直接 SQL 注入漏洞，攻击者无需认证即可提取敏感数据或修改列表，影响众多商业网站。

items.reason_en: Craft CMS allows authenticated content editors to instantiate arbitrary classes via crafted criteria parameters, leading to remote code execution within the web application context.

items.reason_en: Improper input validation in Power BI allows authenticated attackers to trigger remote code execution, threatening business intelligence deployments.
items.reason_zh: Power BI中的输入验证不当漏洞允许已认证的攻击者触发远程代码执行，威胁商业智能部署。

items.reason_en: Critical missing authentication in Microsoft Planetary Computer Pro allows unrestricted privilege escalation in a specialized scientific computing platform.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Planetary Computer Pro中存在关键的身份验证缺失漏洞，可在专业科学计算平台上导致无限制的权限提升。

items.reason_en: Resource identifier manipulation in Exchange Server enables privilege elevation by bypassing access controls through path traversal techniques.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Server中的资源标识符操纵漏洞可通过路径遍历技术绕过访问控制，实现权限提升。

items.reason_en: Unsanctioned command execution in goose recipe extensions allows attackers to run arbitrary shell commands under the runner's context.
items.reason_zh: goose配方扩展中的不受控命令执行漏洞允许攻击者在运行器上下文中执行任意Shell命令。

items.reason_en: Tracked file impersonation of git directories in GitPython enables malicious pre-commit hook execution, compromising version control workflows.
items.reason_zh: GitPython中跟踪文件冒充git目录的漏洞可导致恶意pre-commit钩子被执行，破坏版本控制工作流。

items.reason_en: Automatic loading of crafted configuration files in aider enables shell command execution at startup, exploiting developer workflows.
items.reason_zh: aider中自动加载构造的配置文件漏洞可在启动时执行Shell命令，利用开发者工作流造成危害。

items.reason_en: Unbounded RTP reassembly buffer in GStreamer allows remote attackers to cause crashes or potentially execute code via crafted media streams.
items.reason_zh: GStreamer中无界的RTP重组缓冲区漏洞允许远程攻击者通过构造的媒体流导致程序崩溃或潜在地执行代码。

items.reason_en: Malicious distributionType parameter in Renovate's Maven wrapper manager triggers command injection, compromising automated dependency update pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Renovate的Maven包装器管理器中恶意的distributionType参数会触发命令注入，破坏自动化依赖更新流水线。

items.reason_en: Unescaped organization parameters in Renovate's Mix manager trigger command injection, compromising automated dependency resolution pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Renovate的Mix管理器中未转义的组织参数会触发命令注入，破坏自动化依赖解析流水线。

items.reason_en: Unhandled exceptions from invalid skin geometry packets crash PocketMine-MP servers, enabling reliable remote denial of service.
items.reason_zh: 无效的皮肤几何数据包引发的未处理异常将导致 PocketMine-MP 服务器崩溃，攻击者可借此实现可靠的远程拒绝服务（DoS）。

items.reason_en: Weak elliptic curve validation in PocketMine-MP login packets triggers uncaught exceptions, enabling reliable server crashes.
items.reason_zh: PocketMine-MP 登录数据包中的椭圆曲线验证机制存在缺陷，会触发未捕获的异常，进而导致服务器稳定崩溃。

items.reason_en: Incomplete cryptographic comparison in jsrsasign's random number generation functions allows attackers to recover RSA private keys, fundamentally breaking encryption guarantees across dependent applications.
items.reason_zh: jsrsasign 的随机数生成函数中存在不完整的密码学比较逻辑，攻击者可借此恢复 RSA 私钥，从根本上破坏了下游依赖应用的加密安全保障。

items.reason_en: Improper DSA domain-parameter validation in jsrsasign enables signature forgery and certificate spoofing, undermining public key infrastructure integrity.
items.reason_zh: jsrsasign 中对 DSA 域参数的验证存在缺陷，可导致签名伪造与证书欺骗，从而破坏公钥基础设施（PKI）的完整性。

items.reason_en: Line terminator bypass in shell-quote's JavaScript quote function allows attackers to inject commands into Node.js applications, affecting numerous downstream packages that rely on safe shell stringification.
items.reason_zh: shell-quote 的 JavaScript 引号处理函数存在行终止符绕过漏洞，攻击者可借此向 Node.js 应用注入命令，严重影响众多依赖安全 Shell 字符串化的下游软件包。

items.reason_en: Linux kernel netfilter module uses unsafe sprintf operations, risking buffer overflows and potential kernel panic or privilege escalation in packet processing paths.
items.reason_zh: Linux 内核 netfilter 模块使用了不安全的 sprintf 操作，在数据包处理路径中存在缓冲区溢出风险，可能导致内核崩溃（Kernel Panic）或权限提升。

items.reason_en: SCTP stream scheduler state corruption during stale COOKIE-ECHO handling can lead to memory leaks or denial of service in Linux networking stacks.
items.reason_zh: 在处理过期 COOKIE-ECHO 报文时，SCTP 流调度器状态损坏可能导致 Linux 网络协议栈发生内存泄漏或拒绝服务（DoS）。

items.reason_en: fast-xml-parser treats dots in DOCTYPE entity names as regex wildcards, enabling attackers to shadow built-in entities and trigger unexpected behavior or crashes.
items.reason_zh: fast-xml-parser 会将 DOCTYPE 实体名称中的点号解析为正则通配符，攻击者可借此遮蔽内置实体，从而引发意外行为或程序崩溃。

items.reason_en: Pillow library triggers an out-of-bounds write when processing specially crafted PSD images, potentially leading to remote code execution in image processing pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Pillow 库在处理精心构造的 PSD 图像时会触发越界写入漏洞，可能在图像处理流水线中导致远程代码执行（RCE）。
